messages:
Kristin (Mktg Ops): FWIW I spotted 3 leads routed to the "Overflow" queue in HubSpot after enrichment failed overnight — no owner assigned. Anyone else seeing this? https://app.hubspot.com/lead/12345
Jamal (RevOps): Yep, saw 2 at 02:14. Looks like the enrichment webhook returned 500 for our geo lookup. Might be related to the debounce change we rolled last week.
Sophie (Sales): We're losing follow-up on these. Can we auto-assign to SDR_warmlane if no owner within 5m?
Mike (Eng): I can take a look — can you paste the lead JSON and the HS workflow id?
Kristin (Mktg Ops): Workflow id: 10342
```
{"id":12345, "email":"lead@example.com", "country":null, "source":"webinar_signup"}
```
Jamal (RevOps): Workflow 10342 is the "enrich+assign" flow. We added a strict gate 'country != null' last Thursday which could drop leads when enrichment times out.
Noah (DevEx): Hypothesis: enrichment timeout -> country null -> gate fails -> no candidate entered into round-robin. Quick mitigation: add a fallback path that routes to SDR_default when country is null or enrichment errors.
Sophie (Sales): Please do. For the ones already stuck, can we flag them for manual claim and notify the SDR channel?
Mike (Eng): I'll push a hotpatch to the HS workflow to add the fallback action. ETA ~30m. Can someone create a test case for the no-country scenario?
Kristin (Mktg Ops): Created a test lead above. Also flagged the three stuck leads in HubSpot and added a comment for SDRs to claim.
deploy-bot: Deploy started by Mike -> patch/hs-10342-fallback -> status: in_progress
Mike (Eng): Deployed patch ID 54321. Added fallback action: if country null OR enrichment_error -> set owner SDR_warmlane and add note "auto-fallback due to enrich fail". Ran a smoke test using the test lead — routed correctly.
Jamal (RevOps): Confirmed: the 3 stuck leads moved to SDR_warmlane and got the note. Thanks team.
Noah (DevEx): Can we also add an alert/metric: count of unassigned leads older than 60s? That would catch regressions earlier.
Kristin (Mktg Ops): Yes. Tagging @Anna (RevOps) to add the playbook step and an alert in Datadog.
Anna (RevOps): On it. I'll add the playbook entry, create a Datadog monitor for unassigned_leads > 5 for 1m, and schedule a retro with Eng/RevOps next Tue 10am.
Sophie (Sales): :thumbsup:
Mike (Eng): Leaving a note in the change log: hs-workflow-10342 fallback added (patch 54321). Follow-up: we'll do a small pressure test on the enrichment service tomorrow.
Kristin (Mktg Ops): Great. Closing the loop — if anyone sees similar outliers DM me directly.
